justification: In `core/src/main/java/com/google/googlejavaformat/java/JavaInputAstVisitor.java`, `AllowLeadingBlankLine` is a small protected enum with only two values and a single `valueOf(boolean)` helper. Repo-wide search found no references outside this file, and within the file it is only passed into `visitBlock`/`visitStatement` and checked in one `if` branch, so it does not show the high fan-in/fan-out expected of a hub-like modularization smell.
